2. Observe the main product listing area

Title: Verify registered user can log in with valid credentials
Preconditions: User account exists on Toolshop (register in pre-step or use prior registered user)

1. Open https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/auth/login
2. Enter valid email and password
3. Click Login
Expected Result: User is logged in and is redirected to an authenticated area (e.g. account or home with user session active).

Title: Verify COD checkout with Confirm twice and invoice in My Invoices
Preconditions: User is logged in; cart contains at least two products or one product with quantity updated to 2
Test Data: Billing address per checkout form (valid country and postal); Payment: Cash on Delivery
Steps:
1. Log in and add multiple products or update cart quantity to 2
2. Proceed to checkout
3. Enter billing details and select Cash on Delivery
4. Press Confirm once and wait for payment success indication
5. Press Confirm a second time as required for invoice generation
6. Navigate to My Invoices
Expected Result: A new invoice is listed under My Invoices reflecting the completed order.
